Health Minister J P Nadda Hospitalised for Coronary Angiography

Union Health Minister J P Nadda was admitted to AIIMS Delhi and underwent a coronary angiography. The procedure was performed at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in Delhi. Further details regarding his condition or the outcome of the procedure were not immediately available in the coverage.
